about: Take off into a satisfying puzzle adventure in Block Cascade – a colorful block-clearing game where every move sends a chain reaction across the board. Tap and clear groups of matching blocks, trigger huge cascades, and free up the plane’s path to reach the next destination.
Master 150 handcrafted levels, each with its own layout, obstacles, and objectives. Plan your moves, watch the blocks tumble into place, and set up the perfect combo to clear the board with style.
Boost your game with powerful power-ups:
Time Freeze – Pause the pressure and carefully plan your next big cascade.
Hammer – Smash a stubborn block that’s blocking your perfect move.
Magnet – Pull blocks together to form massive groups and explosive clears.

Whether you play for a few minutes or get lost in “just one more level”, Block Cascade offers a relaxing yet addictive puzzle experience for all ages. Remove the colorful blocks, free up the plane, and see how far your cascades can take you! ✈️🧱
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
